children: Shares of PROG Holdings rose after the company agreed to a $100 million accelerated share purchase program with Bank of America.
Shares were up 7.7% to $37.44 in Monday afternoon trading. The stock has gained 27% this year.

The financial technology holding company on Monday said it had paid $100 million to the bank for an initial delivery of roughly 2.59 million shares. The total number of shares covered by the program will be determined by the end of the first quarter of 2027, when the program is set for final settlement.
PROG Holdings said it is funding the buybacks with existing cash and borrowings under its credit agreement. The purchases are being executed under the company's existing stock buyback program.
